articles.title: One Fossil Just Overturned 40 Years of Mammal Evolution
articles.summary: A nearly complete fossil from Mongolia's Gobi Desert shows that zhelestids — a group scientists studied for 40 years — were not early placental mammals. They belonged to a completely different branch.

articles.title: Blood Tests Reveal Why Astronauts Get Constipated in Space
articles.summary: New research from the University of Copenhagen and NASA shows that gut bacteria in astronauts switch to fermenting protein within weeks in space. The likely cause: microgravity slows digestion.

articles.title: Starship Reaches Orbit, Then Explodes After Splashdown
articles.summary: SpaceX's Starship reached orbit for the first time on Flight 14, but an engine failure cut the mission short. After splashing down in the Pacific, the rocket exploded — an outcome SpaceX had expected.
